1o64e3p:236: This article details how Parcel Perform, in collaboration with AWS GenAIIC, used Amazon SageMaker AI to perform parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA) of Amazon Nova models to accurately extract structured data from e-commerce emails. The fine-tuned Nova Micro model achieved 94.77% extraction accuracy on the test set, a gain of up to 16.6 percentage points over the baseline, while reducing inference latency by 32% and cost by 50%. This case demonstrates the huge potential of the "small model + domain fine-tuning" strategy in production scenarios.
